item.name: Shipping
item.description: Endpoints managing the integration and calculation of logistics via Spex.

request.description: Calculates dynamic shipping rates based on the customer's city and the number of unique vendors in their active cart.

Saves the mapped Spex sub-areas into the local marketplace database to establish pricing rules.
